_about: Titles that themes up to 2.10.1 wrote into Rank Math's rank_math_title field from seo.json, without the site name. Since 2.11.0 a field that still holds exactly this text is treated as theme-written: the theme removes it once in the admin and ignores it on the front end, so the title builder in inc/ce-seo.php decides the title.
